bagPolicy.summary: III Points does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is no onsite parking at Factory Town. Carpooling or using rideshare services is highly recommended. Be cautious of unauthorized parking operators near the venue.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in III Points's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at III Points varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by III Points, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in III Points's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at III Points. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at III Points. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
